title: I'm feeling tired because I went to sleep late.
scene: 走路拖着脚，又累又无聊。

dialogue.speaker: Dad
dialogue.line: You're dragging your feet today. Are you okay?

dialogue.speaker: Child
dialogue.line: I'm feeling tired because I went to sleep late.

dialogue.speaker: Dad
dialogue.line: You did stay up late last night.

dialogue.speaker: Child
dialogue.line: And I'm also bored of walking so much.

dialogue.speaker: Dad
dialogue.line: Are you bored, or are you tired?

dialogue.speaker: Child
dialogue.line: I think I'm both. Can I have a piggyback ride?

dialogue.speaker: Dad
dialogue.line: You can have one, but only up to the corner.
